Scenario: POST /voice/execute for CHANGE_CATEGORY
Expected Result: Confirmed functional gap: identical 400 fallthrough as CANCEL_LEAVE

Expected Result: Always 400 "Adding unknown locations via voice is not fully supported yet" — a permanent dead end by design

Expected Result: intent='UNKNOWN' returned with 200 (not an error); client falls back to its own separate keyword-navigation table, and if that also fails, nothing happens with zero user-visible feedback

Expected Result: 400 "Missing employee information"

Scenario: Call /voice/intent or /voice/execute without voice.use
Expected Result: 403 server-side, but the frontend shows NO visible error at all — confirmed gap: the mic silently appears to do nothing for a permission-less user

Expected Result: 403 inline check (same as the manual PATCH path's guard)

Scenario: Add a holiday via voice without holidays.manage
Expected Result: 403 inline check

Scenario: A name scoring just within vs just outside the 0.3 (primary) / 0.4 (fallback) Fuse thresholds
Expected Result: Just-within accepted as a match; just-outside falls through to null/no-match

Scenario: Transcript naming two employees with very similar names
Expected Result: Single best-score winner silently picked — no tie-break or "did you mean" branch exists at any threshold boundary

Scenario: Confirm no Zod/schema validation exists on POST /voice/execute at all

Scenario: POST /voice/intent with a missing/empty transcript
Expected Result: 400 rejected (the one manual check that does exist)

Scenario: Trigger a Speech API network error mid-listen
